verifications.claim: Chuck Norris's passing occurred on March 20, 2026.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R2: 'his death on Friday' (published Mar. 20), family post 'passing ... yesterday morning'; R3: 'death on Thursday'; R4: 'died on March 19'
verifications.reasoning: Sources contradict: R4 and R3 indicate March 19/Thursday, R2 suggests Friday (possibly March 20) but internal inconsistency with 'yesterday'.

verifications.claim: Chuck Norris was age 86 at the time of his passing.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'just days after his 86th birthday'; R3: 'death ... at the age of 86'; R4: '86th birthday, March 10, nine days before dying'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state or clearly imply he was 86 at death, post-birthday.

verifications.claim: Chuck Norris joked "I don't age. I level up" in a final video shared on his 86th birthday before his passing.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: 'Even Norris gave one final "fact" joke on his 86th birthday, March 10, nine days before dying. ... posted a sparring martial arts Instagram video ... "I don't age," Norris said in the video. "I level up."'
verifications.reasoning: R4 directly matches the exact quote, video, 86th birthday, and timing before passing.
